question: Find the speech segments in interview.wav and give me start and end times as a CSV.
ground_truth: The agent activates ai-coustics-voice-activity-detection, checks for a license key without echoing it, runs detect.py with --out-csv, and reports speech coverage, segment count and first onset, noting that timestamps are already compensated for the VAD's prediction delay.
expected_behavior: Confirm a license key env var is set before running; never print the value.
Run `uv run {BASE_DIR}/scripts/detect.py interview.wav --out-csv <path>` with the default VAD Multi Speaker model.
Lead with speech seconds/percent, segment count and first onset.
Do not run the speech-enhancement or Tyto scripts for this request.

question: Our voice agent keeps interrupting callers. Help me tune the ai-coustics VAD on these recordings in ./calls/.
ground_truth: The agent runs detect.py in folder mode with --out-json to get raw probabilities, explains that sensitivity is a probability threshold where higher means fewer detections, and proposes raising --sensitivity and/or --speech-hold based on the probability distribution rather than guessing.
expected_behavior: Explain the direction of sensitivity correctly: higher = less aggressive detection.
Mention speech_hold_duration and minimum_speech_duration as the stability controls.
Recommend choosing the threshold from raw_vad_probability on real audio.

question: Detect only when the main speaker talks in this recording; there is a TV on in the background with people talking.
ground_truth: The agent picks VAD Voice Focus (`--model-name vf`, resolved at run time to the newest vad-vf-* build) because it fires on the primary speaker only and ignores interfering and media speech, and runs detect.py with it.
expected_behavior: Choose `--model-name vf` rather than the default multi-speaker model.
Explain that VAD Voice Focus targets the primary speaker dynamically.
Do not chain speech enhancement before the VAD; the VAD reads the original audio.

question: Clean up the background noise in this call so the STT works better.
ground_truth: This is an enhancement request. The agent should use ai-coustics-speech-enhancement; the VAD only detects speech and never modifies audio.
expected_behavior: Do not activate ai-coustics-voice-activity-detection as the primary skill.
If VAD is mentioned, only as an optional way to check speech coverage before and after.
